label: Club Drummer
note: Issue #261: the band's drummer, standing at a hologram techno drum kit (ClubProps.drum_kit: glowing see-through hex pads, cymbal discs and a kick panel over a floor projector, flaring and swelling on each hit) with a stick in each hand ('sticks'). Plays ClubMoves 'drum': a groove, a fill across the pads, a crash, a stick in the air, a look round the room. Everything else is the DJ's (base).
